purpose: We are exploring a population insight service for a future partner. The partner has not yet told us whether the result will support care planning, an internal benchmark, or decisions about individual customers; the operational use and intended beneficiaries are still undecided.
question: Please count adults with a recorded hypertension diagnosis, in total.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
Hypertension means conditions.icd10 beginning I10; adult means at least 18 years.
